register_model: register a model architecture with vLLM using a module path string or torch.nn.Module class
inspect_model_cls: inspect model architecture properties like attention type, pooling, and multimodal support from HuggingFace architectures
resolve_model_cls: resolve and load a model class from HuggingFace architecture names with fallback to transformers backend
is_text_generation_model: test if a model architecture is a text generation model based on its registered type
is_multimodal_model: test if a model architecture supports multimodal inputs like images or audio
